# iproute2 compatibility — `org.ono.compat.iproute2`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `ip`, `ss`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## ip-address — `org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-address`

Addresses as `ono.interface-address/1` records, one per address, from `ip -j address`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `ip` |
| versions | `>=5.10` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.interface-address/1` |
| decoder | `json` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `iproute2/ip-address` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ip [-4\|-6] address\|addr\|a [show] [dev <name>] [scope <scope>] [up]` | `ip -j address show` | `-4`, `-6` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `address` | ``, template `{local}/{prefixlen}` |
| `dynamic` | `dynamic` |
| `family` | `family` |
| `index` | `$parent.ifindex` |
| `interface` | `$parent.ifname` |
| `label` | `label` |
| `scope` | `scope` |

### Limits

- `-s/-statistics`, `-d/-details`, `-br/-brief` and `-o/-oneline` change the shape of the answer and are not adapted; the invocation runs raw.
- Lifetimes and the `noprefixroute`/`mngtmpaddr` flags are kept in the extension map, not as canonical fields.

## ip-link — `org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-link`

Interfaces as `ono.interface/1` records, from `ip -j address` so the addresses come along.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `ip` |
| versions | `>=5.10` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.interface/1` |
| decoder | `json` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `iproute2/ip-link` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ip [-4\|-6] link\|l [show] [dev <name>] [up]` | `ip -j address show` | `-4`, `-6` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `addresses` | `addr_info`, template `{local}/{prefixlen}` |
| `index` | `ifindex` |
| `mac` | `address` |
| `mtu` | `mtu` |
| `name` | `ifname` |
| `state` | `operstate` |

### Limits

- `rx_bytes` and `tx_bytes` are not reported: they need `-s`, which is not adapted.
- `ip link set …` and every other mutation stay ordinary external commands (spec v0.3 §1.36).

## ip-route — `org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-route`

Routes as `ono.route/1` records, from `ip -j route`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `ip` |
| versions | `>=5.10` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.route/1` |
| decoder | `json` |

| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `iproute2/ip-route` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ip [-4] route\|r [show] [table <table>] [dev <name>] [proto <protocol>]` | `ip -j route show` | `-4` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `destination` | `dst` |
| `gateway` | `gateway` |
| `interface` | `dev` |
| `metric` | `metric` |
| `protocol` | `protocol` |
| `scope` | `scope` |
| `source` | `prefsrc` |

### Limits

- `ip -6 route` is the `ip-route6` adapter; `ip route get`, `add`, `del`, `change` and `replace` are not adapted.

|---|---|---|---|

## ss-tcp — `org.ono.compat.iproute2.ss-tcp`

TCP sockets as `ono.socket/1` records, from `ss -t` (tier C parser).

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `ss` |
| versions | `>=5.0 <7` |
| tier | C — version-constrained parser |
| schema | `ono.socket/1` |
| decoder | `ss-text-v6` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `iproute2/ss-tcp` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ss -t[a\|l][n][p][e][4\|6] — TCP only, so the Netid column is absent and the protocol is the invocation's` | `ss -H -O -n -e` | `-t`, `-a`, `-l`, `-n`, `-p`, `-e`, `-4`, `-6`, `-m`, `-i`, `-o` | `-t` |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `family` | `family` |
| `inode` | `inode` |
| `local` | `local` |
| `process` | `process` |
| `protocol` | `protocol` |
| `remote` | `remote` |
| `state` | `state` |
| `user` | `user` |

### Limits

- Unix, raw, packet and netlink sockets (`-x`, `-w`, `-0`, `-A`) and filters (`state …`, `dport …`) are not adapted; the invocation runs raw.
- `process` is the owning pid where `-p` and permissions allow, else null with the name in the extension map (spec v0.3 §1.32); queues, timers and cgroups are extensions.
- The parser is pinned to iproute2 5.x–6.x and refuses other versions rather than guessing (spec v0.3 §1.9 tier C).
